tools.name: list_courses
tools.description: List visible generated courses, including pending or locked courses in the selected role path.

tools.name: create_course
tools.description: Create a new editable course under a learning path.

tools.name: workflow_prepare_office_artifact
tools.description: Create a private editable DOCX/XLSX/PPTX, email (EML), or tentative calendar (ICS) draft from an explicit bounded specification and the exact saved result revision. No model call, approval or sharing. Inspect validation and complete content before download/approval.

tools.name: workflow_suggest_document
tools.description: Propose a complete revised document from the preserved original, saved review and current draft. Saves an unapproved version only. Uses tenant AI and may incur usage. Review complete text and changes; never treat generation as approval.

tools.name: workflow_create
tools.description: Create a draft using team_commitments (project and Slack), request_intake or document_review (private submitted run input). Choose project, personal, team with explicit member usernames, or tenant audience. Optional execution_plan supports up to eight dependency-checked draft.compose/draft.review an

tools.name: robbclan_list_workflows
tools.description: Discover connected Robbclan workflows, authorized tools, and office task routes. Approvals happen in this conversation through explicit revision/stage tools; no website confirmation is required. Missing tools indicate role or deployment limits.
